newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul stocks end share lower on consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks end share lower on consolidation.

text.p: Stocks closed slightly lower on Saturday on consolidation following rises caused by better-than-expected economic indicators, dealers said.
South Korea on Wednesday reported its first monthly trade surplus in 30 months for June.
The composite stock index ended at 779.24, down 2.46 points from Friday. Declining issues led advancers by 410 to 353.
A local dealer said the index was expected to move between 770-800 next week but could top the 800 level if there are more positive news on the economy.
